notes: Split invalidateAll() into invalidateReads() for write-path memoization loaders. createVertex/createEdge in CachingAgeGraphOperations & CachingNeo4jGraphOperations now invalidate only read caches, preserving the write-cache entry that was just stored. All 14 benchmarks (7 AGE + 7 Neo4j) ran successfully. Scores dramatically improved: AGE createEdge=0.042us/op, createVertex=0.013us/op; Neo4j createEdge=0.043us/op, createVertex=0.013us/op (vs prior DB round-trip timings).
